name: Danganronpa: One Shot
source:
People have been clinging to the past too much... And now it's time to eliminate one of the founding foundations, the Ultimates. Satoshi Kaugtsuchi wakes up in an old western town along with 15 other Ultimates, being forced to kill by a robotic snake. Will the legacy of the Ultimates fall here, or will the Ultimate Historian document his journey of life and death and keep them alive?

[From [url=https://catstercatster.itch.io/danganronpa-one-shot]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
人们太执着于过去……现在是时候消除终极基础之一了。Satoshi Kaugtsuchi在一个古老的西部小镇中醒来，与其他15名终极战士一起被机器蛇强迫杀死。终极者的遗产会落到这里，还是终极历史学家会记录他的生与死之旅并让他们活下去？

[来自[url=https://catstercatster.itch.io/danganronpa-one-shot]itch.io[/url]]
